price_field_note: Pacific Energy / AES publishes a 2025 RETAIL Price Book with a single 'Retail Price' column. There is no separate dealer/wholesale column, so msrp is populated with the published retail price and dealer_price is left null. Most models require separately-priced components (body + door + surround/legs/trivet); msrp here is the appliance body price unless noted, with required components listed in accessories_required.
